## Purpose
An end-to-end planner benchmark. It plans five reference goals with the real workflow pipeline and models (with auto-accepted review and a Verify dry run), scores each plan, and by default rolls back everything it created. Run it whenever a planning prompt, layer or model route changes.

## Behaviour pinned down
- **`GOALS`** has five fixed goal texts; copy them verbatim:
  - `sme_equipment_finance` (10% deposit, DSCR/LTV, referral above £250,000, moderated decision letter);
  - `insurance_claim_triage`;
  - `invoice_processing` (2% PO tolerance, VAT);
  - `kyc_onboarding` (sanctions/PEP, risk levels, enhanced due diligence);
  - `it_incident_routing` (SLA, P1 escalation).
- **`score(ctx)`** returns:
  - `error`;
  - `contract`: a data contract exists and `check_contract` finds no problems;
  - `valid`: a definition exists and `VALIDATION_FAILED_KEY` is not set;
  - `dry_run`: `metadata.dry_run.passed`;
  - `scenarios`: name, passed and the first 3 problems;
  - `self_repairs`: the count of sublayer events with an id starting `repair_`;
  - `unresolved_checks`: `unresolved_postconditions`;
  - `rewinds`: `REWIND_COUNT_KEY`;
  - `repairs`: applied dry-run repair rounds;
  - `steps`.
- **`plan(goal, keep)`** runs `PipelineContext(query, client)` through `workflow_pipeline.execute`, then scores it and times it. Unless `keep` is set, it calls `plan_control.roll_back_plan(ctx, "benchmark clean-up")`; a clean-up failure is recorded as `cleanup_error`.
- **`main`:**
  - arguments: `--goal` (repeatable, from GOALS), `--keep` and `--out`;
  - `prepare_database(seed_rules=False)`;
  - each goal is isolated, so one exception does not stop the others;
  - prints one line per goal, then "N of M goal(s) planned valid and passed their dry run.";
  - exits 0 only when every goal passed.

## Fixtures, mocks and external dependencies
None mocked. It uses real Mistral calls on the configured models, the real database and the tool service, and creates agents, activities and workflows before rolling them back.

## How to run
From `backend/`:
- `python -m evals.planner_benchmark`;
- `--goal sme_equipment_finance --keep` for one goal, keeping what it created;
- `--out report.json` to write the full report.

## Known gaps and flakiness
- **The results are nondeterministic,** because they depend on the models. It also costs real tokens and takes minutes per goal.
- **The roll-back may leave things behind if it fails;** check `cleanup_error`.
- **It is not part of pytest or CI.**
